Over a game they often contradict their own earlier answers about which letters are in the word, drift to a different word than the one they started with, or even change the word's length part-way through, because nothing holds the word fixed between replies. After each of my letter guesses, reply with only the updated board (reveal every position where the letter occurs) and, if the letter is not in the word, the words `not in the word` after the board.
